subject: Request: tokenized billing visibility + commit tier proposal
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@nebulaai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: visibility into per-token invoice + discounts

Hi Karthik,

Quick one — finance is asking for a line-item export showing per-token counts (prompt vs completion), per-model usage, and the effective rate applied across August/September. They also want a simple table showing what our committed tier would need to look like to qualify for a 15% blended discount versus our current pay-as-you-go spend.

Can you (or someone on your team) share the export format and a proposed commit tier that maps to the blended discount? We have an upcoming vendor review on 10/11 and need this to finalize recommendations.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
NebulaAI

---
Note: we may be moving some inference to on-prem later in the year; this will affect how we think about committed vs usage billing, but for now the ask is purely about hosted API invoices and discounts.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nebulaai.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: visibility into per-token invoice + discounts

Hi Samir — thanks for the note. I can get this over to you. Two quick clarifying points so we give exactly what finance needs:

1) Do they want a historic export (CSV) for August+September with token split by "prompt"/"completion" and model name? We can generate that from our billing pipeline.
2) When you say "blended discount" — should we assume the 15% target is applied to your current average effective rate across models, or do you want a tiered structure that gives deeper discounts at higher committed volumes?

Looping in Marissa and Jordan from commercial to propose the commit tiers and sample quote. Marissa — can you prepare a sample commit schedule (3 tiers) and a one-page quote? Jordan — any margin constraints we should apply?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

On Oct 1, 2026, at 2:02 PM, Samir Patel <samir@nebulaai.com> wrote:
> Quick one — finance is asking for a line-item export showing per-token counts (prompt vs completion)...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: visibility into per-token invoice + discounts

Karthik — drafting a compact approach. Proposed items below (we can attach a PDF quote):

- Deliverable A: CSV export (template attached) with columns: invoice_month, model_name, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, effective_rate_per_1k, line_item_id.
- Deliverable B: Commit tiers (3 levels) mapped to blended discount:
  * Tier 1: 2M tokens/month commit — 7% discount on hosted per-token rates.
  * Tier 2: 10M tokens/month commit — 12% discount.
  * Tier 3: 30M+ tokens/month commit — 18% discount + 30-day SLA uplift.
- Notes: For blended discount calculation we currently weight by model spend; we can show both (a) blended % vs current spend and (b) example savings for Aug/Sep.

Attachments: nebula-usage-export-template.csv, redwood-commit-quote-20261005.pdf (draft).

If Samir needs 15% specifically, Tier 2 is close (12%) and Tier 3 exceeds it. We can offer a one-time true-up credit in Q1 if they hit a 12-month ramp to Tier 3 within 6 months.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

On Oct 2, 2026, at 9:18 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Two quick clarifying points...

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: visibility into per-token invoice + discounts

Looks good to me — tiny edits: make Tier 2 11M tokens/month (instead of 10M) to align with our quarter packaging, and drop the SLA uplift on Tier 3 to a conditional add-on (customer must sign a 12-mo commitment). Otherwise +1.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@nebulaai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: visibility into per-token invoice + discounts

Samir — attached are the CSV template and a draft quote that maps commit tiers to blended discounts (see attached PDF). Summary here so you have it at-a-glance: 

- CSV export: nebula-usage-export-template.csv (attached). We can populate this for Aug and Sep and send back a completed file if you confirm the invoice IDs you want included. The template includes prompt/completion split and per-model rows.
- Proposed commit tiers (finalized):
  * Tier 1: 2,000,000 tokens/month commit — 7% discount
  * Tier 2: 11,000,000 tokens/month commit — 12% discount
  * Tier 3: 30,000,000 tokens/month commit — 18% discount (SLA uplift available as add-on with 12-mo contract)

If your finance team specifically needs a 15% blended discount number, we can show the exact blended rate for Aug+Sep and then: (a) an example 12-mo ramp to reach an equivalent savings, or (b) an ad hoc 15% credit that applies to the first billing cycle after signing (requires exec approval).

Next steps:
1) Tell me which invoice months/IDs to include (we can do Aug and Sep).
2) Confirm whether you want a populated CSV back from us or the blank template.
3) If you want the 15% hard number, say so and I'll scope the one-time credit option with ops.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-minute call if that helps the vendor review.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nebula-usage-export-template.csv (CSV stub), redwood-commit-quote-20261005.pdf (draft quote)
